study_design: Matched case-control pilot study comparing men diagnosed with prostate cancer with healthy controls
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Plasma samples from 116 Caucasian men diagnosed with late onset of prostate cancer and 132 matched controls from the South Australian population were collected and analysed for their concentration of micronutrients.
reason: The abstract compares men with prostate cancer against healthy controls but provides no stage, grade, metastatic, lethal, or other aggressive prostate cancer analysis. Late onset is not an aggressive disease definition.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Higher prostate cancer risk is significantly associated with plasma levels below the median of lycopene (OR: 2.24), α-carotene (OR: 2.13), β-carotene (OR: 1.97) and high levels above the median of iron (OR: 2.31), calcium (OR: 4.35) and sulphur (OR: 2.39).
estimate_classifications.reason: The lycopene estimate concerns prostate cancer generally, with no aggressive subtype defined. The supplied row is the reciprocal orientation of the reported comparison.
